notes: Every measurement is from real bytes (git lfs pull); LFS pointers fail the tool instead of producing numbers.
Per-cue/per-variant loudness/true-peak only, NOT a mix PASS: no combined mix, no VO, no ducking was measured.
All 173 cues are loop=False one-shots, so no loop-seam indicator applies (unlike the music/ambience pack).

186 of 519 runtime variants are shorter than 400 ms, so EBU R128 gated integrated LUFS is not measurable for them (ffmpeg loudnorm returns -inf); those variants carry integrated_lufs=null plus a decoded RMS level in dBFS (short_clip_level_dbfs_rms), which is NOT a LUFS value, and their true peak remains valid. The other 333 variants have finite integrated LUFS.
All cues remain RENDERED_CANDIDATE + REQUIRES_PRESENTATION_ADAPTER in the manifest: measured, not yet runtime-connected, not final.
